answer: Make attestation weight convex in staked timber: vote weight scales with stake squared times epochs tenured, so a second clone costs more than the first, never the same. Bind kin at the root: wallets funded from one parent post jointly-slashed collateral, like willow shoots off a single root — slash one clone and every sibling drains too. Cross-cluster quorums then cap how much finality one funding tree can supply. An attacker flooding an ocean of fresh identities pays super-linearly per head and cannot pool that risk, because correlated faults burn the whole root set at once.
